arithmetic.question: in what fraction of a declared environment family does memory pay
arithmetic.period_rule: the read period is fixed by the price alone, from FINDING-157, so that no environment can be searched for a flattering period
arithmetic.contrast: lifetime(intact, p*) - lifetime(sighted); both pay the same price
arithmetic.delta: a tenth of the control lifetime: delta(theta) = 0.1*max(lifetime(sighted), 1)
arithmetic.why_relative: lifetimes on this grid span three to twenty thousand steps, so an absolute threshold would mean different things in different rows
arithmetic.replication: the unit of replication is the environment, not the seed: FINDING-158 measured sigma = 0 across twelve seeds on a fixed scene
arithmetic.prediction: memory pays in a minority of environments. On a peaked field the remembered cell is reached at most one cell per interval (FINDING-157), so dF should be positive mostly where the spacing is 4, and near zero or negative where the spacing is 8. p_memory below 0.5 would say the question is answerable here only for short spacings

fires.evidence: at least one environment pays memory more than a tenth of the control

silent.evidence: at read_cost = 0 memory wins in 0 of 216 environments: when looking is free, not looking buys nothing

specific.evidence: the wins appear when reading has a price and vanish when it does not: the win rate is 0.30 at cost 0.05 against 0.00 at cost 0

verdict.reason: Across 216 environments from the declared prior and three read prices, memory beats the memoryless follower by more than a tenth of the control in 86 of 648 cases (p_memory = 0.133, Wilson 95% [0.109, 0.161]). The wins are not spread evenly: at read_cost = 0 memory wins in 0 of 216 environments, because when looking is free there is nothing to save, while at cost 0.05 it wins in 65 of 216. So the answer is neither 'memory pays' nor 'memory does not pay': it pays in a minority of a declared family, and the fraction is what the question was always able to answer. Not claimed: that this fraction transfers to any other family or weight.

limitations: this is a statement about the declared prior, not about all environments: another family, or other weights inside this one, would give another number
the read period is fixed by the price, one value per price. A per-environment period would raise the win rate and would be tuning; it is not done
one seed per environment: FINDING-158 measured sigma = 0 across seeds on a fixed scene, so the environment is the unit of replication - but only that scene was checked for determinism
the probe wraps movement around a ring; Field and Life do not, and without wrapping a one-dimensional walk has a return period of at most two
lifetimes on the peaked field are short (units to tens of steps), so the contrast measures survival on a knife edge rather than ecology
memory here stores one cell. A buffer of several slots, needed for a real sham-address control (Q-010), is still not implemented

mde.rule: an effect smaller than `effect` at `sigma_between_seeds` and `arms_needed` is `void`, not `failed`: the instrument could not see it, the world did not answer no
